# RiskVoid Security Agent Kit

> A self-hosted, open-source (Apache-2.0) AI security agent for authorised penetration testing and code review.
> A planner model plans and writes the report; a separate worker model runs 45+ security tools in a Kali Linux
> sandbox. A per-engagement firewall enforces the scope, intrusive commands wait for a human approval bound to the
> exact command, every piece of evidence is hashed, and the audit log is out of the agent's reach. It produces
> client reports (HTML, Word, PDF, Excel) and SARIF, and ships an isolated practice lab and an evidence-based
> benchmark harness. Runs on macOS and Linux with Docker; no GPU needed.

Key facts:
- Repository: https://github.com/RiskVoid/Security-Agent-Kit
- Project page: https://riskvoid.com/security-agent-kit
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/RiskVoid/Security-Agent-Kit.git && cd Security-Agent-Kit && ./rvkit setup`
- Work covered: source code review (OWASP ASVS 5.0), secrets, supply chain, web applications (OWASP WSTG 4.2),
  REST and GraphQL APIs (OWASP API Top 10), AI applications and MCP servers (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS),
  external networks (PTES), authenticated multi-tenant testing, and Laravel as a complete reference workflow.
- Not supported as complete workflows: Active Directory, cloud accounts, Kubernetes, mobile, Windows hosts.
